name: Closed RO
_notes: screens holds paths only. The host comes from KPI_BASE_URL at run time, because this
file is committed and the tenant hostname is a customer's.
This module is compared record by record, not grid by grid. Both screens publish it as a
listing of individual ROs, so the grids pair on row labels but no column inside them
aligns — which the engine reports as a limitation while the record and analytics passes
carry the module. That is the correct outcome here, not a failure to configure.
Last verified: 100 records x 14 columns = 1400 cells, 1184 matched (332 of those only
after allowing for formatting differences), 154 different, 62 missing. Analytics: 9
cards compared, 4 different, 7 DMS cards with no counterpart.
COVERAGE LIMIT: this module has 422 records and only 100 are compared. AutoGroup's
rows-per-page control offers no option above 100, so even with the paginator driven to
its maximum the listing stops there, while DMS shows all 422. The 322 unmatched DMS
records are reported as one-side-only rather than as differences. Full coverage needs
the capture to page through AutoGroup and merge the pages, which it does not yet do.
Encouragingly, widening from 25 to 100 records did not change the match ratio at all:
84.6% both before and after. The additional records behave like the first 25, so the
154 differences look like a consistent pattern rather than a long tail.
The differences and the 332 formatting-only matches are the open question on this
module and want a look before rules are added — a formatting-only match means the two
screens present the same record inconsistently, which is worth knowing either way.
Note: this module is now the slowest to capture, around 14 minutes, because the DMS
listing renders all 422 records.
